title: Steer Model beyond Assistant: Controlling System Prompt Strength via Contrastive Decoding
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on general instruction following, persona adoption, capability modulation, and stylistic control.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was not a part of its investigation.
